treatments.Healthy: No treatment needed. Continue regular monitoring and balanced NPK fertilization.
treatments.Apple Scab: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/litre water; remove fallen leaves to reduce inoculum.
treatments.Common Rust: Apply Propiconazole 25% EC at 1ml/litre; plant resistant varieties next season.
treatments.Black Rot: Remove infected berries; spray Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/litre during early season.
treatments.Early Blight: Apply Chlorothalonil 75% WP at 2g/litre; maintain adequate plant spacing for airflow.
treatments.Late Blight: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb at 2.5g/litre immediately; destroy infected plant material.
treatments.Leaf Blight: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/litre water; remove and destroy infected leaves.
treatments.Brown Spot: Apply Propiconazole 25% EC at 1ml/litre; ensure proper potassium fertilization.
treatments.Bacterial Spot: Apply copper oxychloride 50% WP at 3g/litre; ensure field drainage and rotate crops.
treatments.Powdery Mildew: Spray wettable sulphur 80% WP at 2g/litre or neem oil 3ml/litre every 7 days.
treatments.Leaf Rust: Apply Propiconazole 25% EC at 1ml/litre; avoid overhead irrigation.
